exposure: gestational diabetes with poor glycemic control
cohort: Infants born between 34 0/7 weeks and 36 6/7 weeks of gestation were included in the study.
finding: Postnatal environmental factors, such as maternal-child union and breastfeeding, are directly related to early hypoglycemia development.
mod_finding: Planned cesarean delivery is associated with a higher probability of early neonatal hypoglycemia.
